title: Aliens have visited humanity for a very long time

tellings.quote: several times. Um my impression was that they've been here for a very long time.

plain: Aliens have been coming to Earth for a very long time, says a former sergeant named Dan Sherman, who tells Michels the NSA hired him in the early 1990s to communicate with them. He says this was the impression he took away from his exchanges with them, which came up several times, and if true it would mean humans have shared their history with visitors for ages.
